TdZ51n9K550u.code:
// @title Computer says no
// @by Reinbim

p1: stack(s("[[bd bd cp hh*2] | [bd:2 ~ hh lt:2] | [[hh,bd:3] hh:2 hh cp]]")
      .fast(3)
      .swing(0.5)
      .decay("<0.1 .5 .3>*4")
      .sometimes(x=>x.speed("<0.2 0.5 1>*3"))
      .velocity(rand.range(0.1,1).fast(20))
      .sometimesBy(0.01,x=>x.echo(5,1/32,0.5))
      .room(0.1)
      .lpf("[1000 2000] <3000 6000 500>*2")
      .lpe(sine.range(5,20))
      .gain(2.2)
    .bank("RolandTR909")
)

p2: stack(s("[[sh hh*2 [<~ oh>] rim]]").cut(1)
      .fast(3)
      .swing(0.5)
      .decay("<0.1 .5 .3>*4")
      .velocity(rand.range(0.1,1).fast(10))
      .sometimesBy(0.2,x=>x.jux(rev))
      .bpf("<8000 4000>")
      .room(0.2)
      .gain(1)
    .bank("AlesisHR16")
)

p3: stack(n("0 8 4 7".add("<0 [3 8] 7 4 1>/8")).scale("A:major") 
    .s("<square supersaw>*2")
    .off(0.25, x=>x.transpose("-12"))
    .decay(perlin.range(0.1, 0.5).slow(4))
    .release(perlin.range(0.7, 2.5).slow(3))
    .fast(3)
    .lpf(perlin.range(500, 3000))
    .lpe(20)
)

p4: stack(n("[0,9,2,5]! | [~ [4,3,1,12]] | [[0,9,2,5] [7,2,0,4]]".slow(3)
    .sometimes(x=>x.add("< 1 2 5 8>".slow(4)).transpose("1"))).jux(rev)
    .scale("A:major") 
    .swing(4)
    .s("<triangle>")
    .off(0.25, x=>x.transpose("24"))
    .decay(perlin.range(1, 2).slow(4))
    .release(perlin.range(2, 5).slow(3))
    .fast(5)
    .room(2)
    .gain(0.1)
    .lpf(tri.range(0, 5000).fast(10))
    .lpe(20)
)

FzjlfJxXkn9N.code:
//@title "monopatín sideral"
//@by "Ángel Jara"

setcps(123/60/4)


laBateria:
stack(
s("bd*2 , sd(2,4,1), hh*8")._pianoroll(),
s("<-@7 [- - [sd:0:0.5(5,8,<0!2 1!2>)]@2]>")
  .color("#f00")
  ._pianoroll(),
s("oh*16").gain(rand.range(0,0.7)).legato(0.25).mask("[0 1 0 0] [1 0 1 1]")
  .color("#f0f")
  ._pianoroll())

elBajo:
note("e2(3,8) b1(3,8) d2(3,8) [[g1*2 a1*2] d2*2]").s("sawtooth").slow(4).legato("0.9")

elAcorde:
note("[e3, g3, b3, d3](3,8,1) [b3, d3, fs3, a3](3,8,1) [d3, fs3, a3, c3](3,8,1) [[[g3, b3, d3, fs3](2,4,1) [a3, c3, e3, g3](2,4,1)] [d3, fs3, a3, c3](2,4,1)]")
  .s("square").slow(4).legato("0.25")
  .color("#0ff")
  ._pianoroll()

let laMelodia =
n(irand(12)).struct("x*64")
  .scale("E3:minor:pentatonic")
  .degradeBy(0.5)
  .ribbon("<[<1337!3 25>]!3 [<1377!3 50>]>", 4)
  .slow(4)
  .legato(0.7).s("sawtooth")  
  .mask("0!32 1!96 1!128 ")
  .color("#00f")

let elArpegio =
note("[e4, g4, b4, d4] [b4, d4, fs4, a4] [d4, fs4, a4, c4] [[[g4, b4, d4, fs4] [a4, c4, e4, g4]] [d4, fs4, a4, c4]]")
  .s("square")
  .arp("[0 1 2 3 0 1 0 3]*4")
  .slow(4).legato("0.25")
  .color("#50d")


alaMelodia:
arrange([2,silence], [6,laMelodia]
       , [4,elArpegio], [4,laMelodia])  
  ._pianoroll()


//Em7 Bm7 D7 Gma7 Am7 D7
